title: Inventory remaining magic item mechanics and create category slices
description:

- Ensure the broad magic-item finding is fully decomposed.
- Categories may include consumables, transformations, deck/flask/apparatus tables, command-word activations, curse/drawback effects, movement/flying/swimming, sensory/detection effects, and spell storage/casting.

- Create additional child beads as needed for unresolved categories.
- Update readiness reporting to avoid counting known unmodeled magic item mechanics as green.
